news.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
news.summary: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.

news.title: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs
news.summary: Google's PageBreak agent autonomously finds and verifies real vulnerabilities in its own web apps, cutting through the flood of noisy AI-generated security reports.

news.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
news.summary: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

news.title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
